apps.name: Adhan Clock
apps.tagline: The call to prayer on every screen and speaker in the house.
keywords: adhan clock azan azaan athan call to prayer salah salat namaz prayer times fajr dhuhr asr maghrib isha alexa echo nest android tv muslim islam

llms.text: a calm full-screen prayer clock that plays the adhan at each of the five daily prayers (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha); Fajr has its own adhan. Prayer times are calculated on the device (check the settings with your local masjid). Web clock ready now, on any screen with a browser, TVs included: open adhantv.live on the TV and set it up from your phone with the QR code or short code it shows (portrait or landscape); Android phone, tablet and Android TV / Google TV app as an APK now, Google Play coming soon (testers welcome at /beta); an Android phone, tablet or Google TV on the same Wi-Fi casts the adhan to your Google Nest speakers and Nest Hubs; an Alexa skill for Echo and Echo Show is live on the Alexa Skills Store (US) (say "Alexa, enable Adhan Clock", sign in with Amazon to link your prayer settings (the linking page fills in your area from your internet connection; the place, calculation and adhans can be changed there), then add one Routine; https://adhantv.live/alexa walks through the four steps, checks each one as Alexa reports it after you sign in with Amazon, and has a "Test my Echo" button that plays a short test adhan on your Echo through your Routine; "Alexa, ask Adhan Clock to play the adhan" also understands azan, azaan, athan and call to prayer; it also answers questions such as "Alexa, ask Adhan Clock when is the next prayer", what time is Asr, what are the prayer times today, when is iftar, when does suhoor end and what is the Hijri date); a masjid profile lets one admin keep every screen's settings and uploaded adhans in step, and each screen keeps its own orientation; a choice of openly licensed adhans with previews (Makkah 2018 by default, Malmö for Fajr), and the dua after the adhan is read aloud after each adhan; old phones and tablets can be a dedicated clock (guide: https://adhantv.live/devices). No accounts, no ads, no analytics in the clock; location stays on the device; only Alexa or Google Home linking and a masjid profile store prayer settings (coordinates, time zone, choices) on the server (a masjid profile also keeps its uploaded adhans), and setting up a TV from your phone holds them for 15 minutes at most. Interactive setup guide: https://mutaafaziz.com/adhan/ https://adhantv.live https://adhantv.live/android

resume.text: A calm full-screen prayer clock that plays the adhan at each of the five daily prayers (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha), with prayer times calculated on the device. Runs on the web, as an Android phone, tablet and TV app (APK), casts to Google Nest speakers from Android, and is live as an Alexa skill in the US. No accounts, no ads, no analytics in the clock. App: https://adhantv.live

apps.name: KIN
apps.tagline: A tiny creature that hops between screens.
keywords: kin creature pet virtual pet tamagotchi companion hatch cocoon weather sky snow rain two screens hop share friend iphone ipad toy

llms.text: a tiny, original, autonomous creature that lives under your real sky; its little diorama follows your actual time of day, sun angle, temperature, wind, rain and snow. It hatches from a cocoon with no signup, you pet it, it has moods and a memory book (visits, hosted visits, its AI director's thoughts and its hatch, kept on the device). Care and play: feed, bath, brush, throw-and-fetch, tuck in, a garden, tricks and collectibles. A Think button asks an AI director (a free edge model, or your own Claude, OpenAI, xAI or Gemini key), shown live in an aurora-field theatre. Put two phones or tablets side by side and slide one finger from one screen onto the other: that invisibly links them (no QR codes), and your KIN hops onto your friend's screen, where their KIN reacts in its own way. Two browser windows side by side on one computer work too. Runs in the browser, including Safari on iPhone and iPad. https://mutaafaziz.com/kin/ https://mutaafaziz.com/kin/about/ https://github.com/mutaaf/kin

resume.text: A tiny autonomous creature that lives under your real sky (time of day, sun angle, temperature, wind, rain, snow). Put two phones or tablets side by side and slide a finger across: they link invisibly and KIN hops onto the other screen. Runs in the browser, including Safari on iPhone and iPad. Source: https://github.com/mutaaf/kin
